relationships.evidence_quote: Our results showed that the VN integrates neuron information from VbC and projects to Sp5c, Sp5c can also accept direct projections from VbC.

key_findings: NTG plus kainic acid mouse model reproduced vestibular migraine allodynia and balance disturbance, with activation of VbC, VN and Sp5c.
TRPV2 expression was increased in Sp5c microglia, suggesting a role in neuron-glia crosstalk in vestibular migraine.
